title: 12 Best Cocktail Bars in Miami — The Unfiltered Guide
description: The best cocktail bars in Miami — curated from Reddit reviews. Sweet Liberty, Café La Trova, Bar Kaiju, ViceVersa, Panamericano Bar and more.

places.name: Sweet Liberty Drinks & Supply Company
places.address: 237 20th St suite b, Miami Beach, FL 33139, USA

redditQuotes.text: An absolute can't-miss when craving cocktails, Sweet Liberty is one of Miami Beach's best cocktail bars. Try to snag the back bar table — it's like a chef's table behind the bar.
redditQuotes.source: — Eater Miami, Essential Cocktail Bars guide, 2025

redditQuotes.text: Sweet Liberty is starting to reach classic status in South Beach. The most impressive thing is how they maintain drink quality even when the bar is slammed.
redditQuotes.source: — The Infatuation, Best Cocktail Bars in Miami

places.verdict: The undisputed king of Miami cocktails — a decade of excellence and still the bar everyone recommends first.

comparison.best for: The complete Miami cocktail experience — happy hour oysters, the best piña colada in town, and a kitchen open until 4 AM.
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 2,648 Google reviews · South Beach Institution
comparison.what to order: The coffee piña colada is legendary. The apple martini and banana julep are also standouts. Get happy hour oysters to start and cauliflower nachos to close.

places.whatToOrder: The coffee piña colada is legendary. The apple martini and banana julep are also standouts. Get happy hour oysters to start and cauliflower nachos to close.
places.editorialSummary: The undisputed king of Miami cocktails — a decade of excellence and still the bar everyone recommends first.
places.bestFor: The complete Miami cocktail experience — happy hour oysters, the best piña colada in town, and a kitchen open until 4 AM.

places.name: Café La Trova

redditQuotes.text: Cafe La Trova is like a museum to Cuban cocktail culture. The bartenders go by cantineros, wear shiny black vests and occasionally whip out instruments to play along with the house band.
redditQuotes.source: — The Infatuation, Best Cocktail Bars in Miami

redditQuotes.text: Cafe La Trova would be a good place to check out. Broken Shaker and Lagniappe are great if the weather is good.
redditQuotes.source: — r/Miami, Best Bars in Miami thread, 2024

places.verdict: A living museum of Cuban cocktail culture — except you can drink the exhibits, so it's more fun.

comparison.best for: Cuban cocktail culture on Calle Ocho with live music, cantineros in black vests, and the best daiquiri in Miami.
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 3,768 Google reviews · Cuban Cocktail Culture
comparison.what to order: The daiquiri — white rum, fresh lime juice, and sugar, shaken so hard there are fragments of chipped ice floating at the surface.

places.name: Bar Kaiju
places.address: 8300 NE 2nd Ave 2nd floor, Miami, FL 33138, USA

redditQuotes.text: Bar Kaiju brings monster-inspired cocktails to Little River. The creative menu is displayed in a binder used to collect Pokémon trading cards.
redditQuotes.source: — Eater Miami, Essential Cocktail Bars guide, 2025

redditQuotes.text: Kaiju makes great cocktails. Each page is designed to look like a Pokémon card, with tasting notes and a brief bio on the mythical monster.
redditQuotes.source: — r/Miami, Best Bars in Miami thread, 2024

places.verdict: The most creative cocktail menu in Miami — each drink designed like a Pokémon card, served in a hidden anime den.

comparison.best for: A hidden bar with unabashedly nerdy attention to detail — Pokémon card-style menus, monster-themed cocktails, and Japanese anime art.
comparison.what to order: The Kappa — a take on a southside with shiso, cardamom, cucumber, and toasted rice syrup. Complimentary milk punch of the week on arrival.

places.whatToOrder: The Kappa — a take on a southside with shiso, cardamom, cucumber, and toasted rice syrup. Complimentary milk punch of the week on arrival.
places.editorialSummary: The most creative cocktail menu in Miami — each drink designed like a Pokémon card, served in a hidden anime den.

places.name: ViceVersa Miami

redditQuotes.text: ViceVersa's cocktails have an Italian soul. The menu revolves around a miraculously good Negroni worthy of making employees sign NDAs.
redditQuotes.source: — The Infatuation, Best Cocktail Bars in Miami

redditQuotes.text: Opened in 2024 in Downtown Miami's Elser Hotel, ViceVersa took the 56th spot in North America's 100 Best Bars.
redditQuotes.source: — BBC Travel, Miami cocktail guide, 2025

places.verdict: The Negroni here is so good they should make employees sign NDAs. Opened in 2024 and already a must-visit.

comparison.best for: Italian-inspired cocktails with a miraculously good Negroni, oversized sbagliato glasses, and fluffy pizza. Happy hour Tue–Fri 5–7 PM.
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 349 Google reviews · Italian-Soul Negroni Bar
comparison.what to order: The Negroni — it's what ViceVersa is known for. The sbagliatos come in oversized glasses. The pizzas are fluffy masterpieces.

places.name: The Sylvester
places.address: 3456 N Miami Ave, Miami, FL 33127, USA

redditQuotes.text: One step into the Sylvester and you'll feel like you're in your grandmother's Florida sunroom — except it's dimly lit and there's a large disco ball twinkling in the ceiling.
redditQuotes.source: — Eater Miami, Essential Cocktail Bars guide, 2025

redditQuotes.text: The Sylvester has colorful vintage wallpaper, tropical touches, and repurposed antique furniture — much of it from the parents of owner Ben Potts.
redditQuotes.source: — Eater Miami, Essential Cocktail Bars guide, 2025

places.verdict: Your grandmother's Florida sunroom — except dimly lit with a disco ball twinkling on the ceiling.

places.name: Panamericano Bar
places.address: 900 S Miami Ave #260, Miami, FL 33130, USA

redditQuotes.text: This Brickell bar takes reservations and makes you ring a doorbell for entry. Inside, the cocktails are excellent and utilize South American spirits.
redditQuotes.source: — The Infatuation, Best Cocktail Bars in Miami

redditQuotes.text: Panamericano Bar opened as one of the biggest bar openings of 2024 in Miami. It's a heartfelt ode to cocktail snobbery — in the best possible way.
redditQuotes.source: — Miami New Times, Best Bar Openings of 2024

places.verdict: Miami's most theatrical cocktail experience — doorbell entry, blindfolded tastings, and South American spirits you've never heard of.

comparison.best for: A committed speakeasy with doorbell entry, tableside speeches, and some drinks involving candle wishes or being blindfolded by the bartender.
comparison.strengths: 5★ from 1,836 Google reviews · South American Speakeasy
comparison.what to order: Let the bartender guide you — each cocktail comes with an elaborate tableside presentation using South American spirits. This is cocktail theater at its finest.

places.whatToOrder: Let the bartender guide you — each cocktail comes with an elaborate tableside presentation using South American spirits. This is cocktail theater at its finest.
places.editorialSummary: Miami's most theatrical cocktail experience — doorbell entry, blindfolded tastings, and South American spirits you've never heard of.
places.bestFor: A committed speakeasy with doorbell entry, tableside speeches, and some drinks involving candle wishes or being blindfolded by the bartender.

places.name: Broken Shaker

redditQuotes.text: Broken Shaker and Lagniappe are great if the weather is good. Kaiju makes great cocktails.

redditQuotes.text: Broken Shaker helped establish Miami Beach as a serious cocktail destination. The garden setting remains unmatched for outdoor drinking.

places.name: Brother's Keeper Bar
places.address: 1710 Alton Rd, Miami Beach, FL 33139, USA

redditQuotes.text: The Lost Boy team brings high-end cocktails and dive bar vibes to Brother's Keeper. The 25-foot saltwater aquarium and purple neon lights make it feel like Miami Vice.
redditQuotes.source: — Eater Miami, Essential Cocktail Bars guide, 2025

redditQuotes.text: A pool table, darts, and daily happy hour from 5–7 PM make Brother's Keeper a perfect place to hang with friends or go for a casual date.
redditQuotes.source: — Eater Miami, Essential Cocktail Bars guide, 2025

places.verdict: High-end cocktails meet dive bar vibes — a 25-foot saltwater aquarium, purple neon, pool table, and the Bread Service Martini.

redditQuotes.text: Dante's HiFi is all about the tunes. The extensive vinyl library from music director Rich Medina's personal collection sets the mood.

places.name: Over Under
places.address: 151 E Flagler St, Miami, FL 33131, USA

redditQuotes.text: Not only do all cocktails fall within the $14 range — tragically, a steal for a good drink in Miami — but they are balanced, boozy, and expertly stirred and shaken.
redditQuotes.source: — The Infatuation, Best Cocktail Bars in Miami

redditQuotes.text: If you are in a cocktail-appreciating mood, try to go to Over Under during the week. You'll probably spill your oyster shell-infused martini on shoulder-to-shoulder Saturdays.
redditQuotes.source: — The Infatuation, Best Cocktail Bars in Miami

places.verdict: The best cocktail value in Miami — every drink around $14, expertly made, with oyster shell-infused martinis.

redditQuotes.text: Miami only has one good tiki bar, and it's Kaona Room. The drinks are strong, heavy on rum, and feature a housemade orgeat we could drink by the glass.

redditQuotes.text: They have a pretty jaw-dropping martini that comes with a huge ice cube carved into the shape of a diamond.
